tbn.printed_text: Total Base Number, mgKOH/g 98-120 109 SH/T 0251, ASTM D2896
tbn.calculation_note: TDS 'Typical Value' column with index/limit '98-120'. Same value in: RF6079%20Diesel%20Engine%20Oil%20Additive%20Package.pdf p.1 (undated): 'Total Base Number, mgKOH/g 109 ASTM D2896'.

sulfated_ash.calculation_note: Sulfated ash = (Ca_ppm×3.40 + Mg_ppm×4.95 + Zn_ppm×1.24)/10000; elements are in wt.% here, so = 3.40×3.44 (Ca) + 1.24×1.5 (Zn) = 13.5560 → 13.56 wt.%. Mg not reported, taken as 0.
sulfated_ash.notes: Sourced from calculation (ASTM D874 sulfated-ash conversion factors applied to the Ca/Mg/Zn contents in this file), not from the product datasheet.

open_questions: TDS DL2-15535.pdf undated; bulletin 'RF6079 Diesel Engine Oil Additive Package.pdf' prints only 'Version 1'; SDS DL2-15541.pdf Issue/Revision 3/18/2022 (body image/vector graphics, read visually). All three agree on the shared values.

SDS p.2 component shares (not element contents): hydrotreated heavy paraffinic distillate 10 – 59.9 %; ZDDP 3 – 17.9 %; overbased calcium sulfurized phenate 1 – 14.9 %; bis(nonylphenyl)amine 0.5 – 9.9 %; hindered phenolic ester 0.5 – 9.9 %.
Sulfated ash, KV40, Mg, B, Mo, S, pour point not printed.

User decision 2026-10-17: density field stores the number 1.0 (g/cm³), which is reported as specific gravity (relative density) ('Relative density : 1.000 g/cm³@20℃', DL2-15541.pdf p.5), not a density in kg/m3; flagged for review.
